name: KIPREIT
recent: KIP REIT 于2026年8月完成2亿新单位的私募配售，每单位0.815令吉，并于10月19日召开第十届年度股东大会，通过发行新单位的授权。最新季度（2026年9月30日止）营收环比增长1.1%，但净利环比大幅下滑81.3%。
notable: 完成2亿新单位的私募配售，每单位发行价0.815令吉，已于2026年8月27日上市。
第十届年度股东大会于2026年10月19日举行，所有决议案以投票方式通过。
risks: 私募配售发行2亿新单位。
最新季度净利环比下降81.3%，同比亦下降78.2%。
earnings: 2026年9月30日止季度营收为4875万令吉，环比增长1.1%，同比增长22.2%；净利为1726万令吉，环比下降81.3%，同比下降78.2%，净利率为35.4%。

recent_en: KIP REIT completed a private placement of 200 million new units at RM0.815 per unit in August 2026 and held its 10th AGM on 19 October 2026, where unitholders approved the authority to issue new units. For the latest quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue rose 1.1% QoQ while net income fell 81.3% QoQ.
notable_en: Completed a private placement of 200 million new units at an issue price of RM0.815 per unit, listed on 27 August 2026.
Held its 10th Annual General Meeting on 19 October 2026, with all resolutions passed by poll.
risks_en: The private placement of 200 million new units may dilute existing unitholders' holdings.
Net income for the latest quarter fell 81.3% QoQ and 78.2% YoY.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue was RM48.75 million, up 1.1% QoQ and 22.2% YoY; net income was RM17.26 million, down 81.3% QoQ and 78.2% YoY, with a net margin of 35.4%.
